description: Slide the door to the right, open the drawer. The door only works as the first step; the drawer works anywhere. Random scenes: the joints the task doesn't fix are random at each reset, the blocks lie somewhere on the table, the conditions are rendered in 4 random scenes. Long runs, see dynaguide_scripts/run_long_runs_1.bat and run_long_runs_2.bat. Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
